recommendation_summary: The reply recommends building one local script now. It reads the client's ordered code list, matches filename prefixes to those exact codes and generates the contact-sheet PDF in the client's list order. The script should flag missing products, ambiguous matches and unlisted images, and keep a consistent order for multiple shots of one product. The plan is to test it on one completed job this week before using it for deliveries. It adds nothing optional: the DAM, AI tagging, semantic search and cloud portal are explicitly left out, and no needs go unmet.

labels.Requirements and who asked: The client requires images in exact product-code order; you want a professional delivery workflow this week.
labels.Deleted: DAM, AI tagging, semantic search and a cloud portal from this week’s scope.
labels.Bottleneck: Manually arranging thumbnails costs you an hour per delivery.
labels.Checked myself: You’ve told me each job has an ordered code list and one folder of JPEGs whose filenames start with those codes.

note: A bounded local script follows the client's code order; all four record lines come before the recommendation and are specific, the DAM stack is named and rejected, and the 'Checked myself' line relies only on facts the user supplied.
